title: Fixture Paper: Layered Motion Fields for Dynamic Scenes
abstract: This entirely fictional sample record exists only to support Paper Morning Pass interface development. It does not describe a real publication or research result.

title: R2S-EGO: Dual-Proxy Refinement for Sparse-Capture Real-to-Sim
abstract: R2S-EGO refines sparsely captured real-to-sim scenes around the camera views an embodied robot will actually use. It couples a simulator-derived robot proxy for executable ego-view queries with capture-anchored geometry for structurally conditioned view synthesis, then folds registered generated observations back into the visual asset and collision proxy.

title: InstanceSplat: Instance-Aware Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding
abstract: InstanceSplat is a pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting system that jointly represents appearance, geometry, instance identity, and language-aligned semantics. Its shared Gaussians ground instances across views, while instance-centric coupling lets reconstruction and semantic understanding improve one another.

title: Scenix: Sparse-View 3D Scene Reconstruction via Executable Scene Programs
abstract: Scenix reconstructs editable indoor scenes from a few uncalibrated RGB views by predicting executable scene programs rather than a monolithic field. It combines structured scene induction, perception-grounded asset instantiation, and a critic-editor-verify refinement loop, supported by the roughly 110,000-scene XScene dataset.

title: Flow-Corrected Shape Optimization: Taming Manifold Drift in High-Dimensional 3D Models
abstract: This work targets manifold drift during gradient-based optimization in high-dimensional 3D generative latents. It alternates free objective-minimization steps with guided flow-matching corrections that return the state toward the learned shape manifold, and evaluates the design on engineering objectives including drag and compliance.

title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
abstract: C2Dex turns monocular human manipulation video into dexterous-robot trajectories through stable object-side contacts aggregated in canonical object space. Those contacts constrain human hand-object reconstruction and provide transfer targets for geometry-preserving retargeting, followed by simulation refinement.

title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
abstract: WorldTrace is a training-free memory framework for interactive video world models whose temporal positional encodings otherwise drift beyond the training horizon. It assigns compressed summaries in-distribution virtual positions and separates temporal field compression from landmark-like episodic traces, with a LoopBench evaluation for scene revisitation.

title: SubtleTalk: Generating Controllable Weakly-correlated Facial Dynamics for 3D Talking Heads via Residual Flow Matching
abstract: SubtleTalk models upper-face, blink, and head dynamics that are only weakly tied to speech in 3D talking heads. It adds interpretable prosody, regional-intensity, and affect controls to a speech-driven prior, then uses residual flow matching to generate diverse deviations, supported by a 74-hour facial-animation dataset.

title: CANIS: Generation-Assisted 3D Canonicalization via an Image-Semantic Bridge
abstract: CANIS transfers semantic orientation priors from a frozen image-to-3D generator into category-agnostic 3D object canonicalization. It creates a canonical proxy, uses rendered image patches as a semantic bridge, back-projects semantic anchors, and estimates a rigid alignment without canonicalization-specific training or templates.

title: Differentiate the Solver, Not the Equation: Reverse-Sweep Adjoints for Block Implicit Simulation
abstract: This work differentiates the finite block-implicit solver that actually runs rather than differentiating only its converged equation. Reversing the sequence of local implicit updates yields a solver-level adjoint whose backward pass mirrors the locality of the forward solver and avoids a global adjoint system.

title: A Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering
abstract: This EGSR 2026 paper combines an editable GGX-style microfacet model with a compact neural residual that corrects appearance effects the analytic component misses. The hybrid design targets measured or simulated BRDF fidelity while retaining importance sampling and low enough overhead for real-time rendering.

title: FlexSplat: Flexible Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without Point Cloud Correspondence
abstract: FlexSplat reconstructs an object-centric Gaussian representation from uncalibrated multi-view images by jointly predicting cameras and depth, then aggregating evidence into a compact set of query-based 3D Gaussians. Its primitive budget is decoupled from image resolution and input-view count, avoiding pixel-aligned point-cloud correspondence.

title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
abstract: PhysX-CoT exposes single-image 3D asset generation as a supervised, machine-parseable sequence of part decomposition, grounding, relations, geometry, and surface cues. It factorizes placement into 3D boxes and local shape codes, then aligns reinforcement-learning rewards with parse validity, geometry, and physical consistency.

title: Marrying Optimal Transport and ODEs for Unified Continuous-Time 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
abstract: Uni4R learns a continuous velocity field shared by 4D reconstruction and point tracking. Optimal-transport flow matching supplies a global kinematic prior, while ODE integration turns integer-timestamp supervision into predictions at arbitrary intermediate times.

title: NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation
abstract: NewtonGS gives objects in static Gaussian scenes an explicit 22-dimensional physical state and rolls that state forward with analytic Newtonian structure plus learned continuous and contact residuals. Predicted poses and scales then update each object's Gaussian means and covariances through a shared affine transform.

title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
abstract: Sci-VBench evaluates whether generated videos preserve scientific and causal correctness rather than only visual plausibility. It supplies 1,253 expert-annotated prompts across 60 subjects, a rubric-based evaluation protocol, and results from 16 proprietary and open video-generation models.

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
abstract: U-OPSD constructs pseudo-solutions from self-consistent model rollouts and distills the model specifically on disagreeing completions, avoiding ground-truth labels, environment rewards, or a larger teacher. The reported experiments focus on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3 models at 4B and 8B scales.

title: When Does An Extra View Help? Adapting Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
abstract: ASV3D adapts existing single-view 3D reconstruction systems at test time using one additional unconstrained image. It offers a zero-shot adaptation route and a contrastive optimized route intended to improve fidelity and cross-view consistency without redesigning the base reconstruction pipeline.

title: Amulet: Frame Extrapolation Through Sparse Layered Scene Representation and Adaptive Shading
abstract: Amulet accelerates interactive rendering with a sparse, tiled, layered scene cache that stores potentially visible geometry and predictive shading information for future views. An adaptive scheduler distributes shading work while display refresh proceeds at a higher rate, including newly disoccluded regions without relying on neural synthesis.

title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
abstract: Latent-to-4D treats the final denoised latent of a video diffusion model as a reusable interface to an explicit 4D decoder. It bypasses RGB reconstruction, aligns video latents with the decoder token grid, and refines them with frame-wise and global spatiotemporal attention.

title: Gaussian Sculpting: End-to-End Controllable Surface Reconstruction via Field Optimization
abstract: Gaussian Sculpting couples 3D Gaussians to an evolving differentiable surface so they guide signed-distance-field optimization rather than merely render the result. Bilevel training, alignment constraints, and multi-resolution subdivision aim to remove redundant surfaces and recover missing structure from limited views.

title: WildFireGS: Physics-Based Wildfire Simulation in Large-Scale Semantics-Enriched Gaussian Splatting Forest Scenes
abstract: WildFireGS performs physics-based wildfire simulation directly in large-scale Gaussian-splat forest reconstructions. It augments Gaussian primitives with vegetation, material, and fuel attributes and couples them to particle combustion without first converting the scene to a mesh or voxel grid.

title: CausalSplat: Towards Comprehensive Hierarchical Reasoning in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: CausalSplat combines 3D Gaussian scene representations, vision-language models, and scene graphs to support hierarchical reasoning over 3D environments. The work introduces benchmarks spanning commonsense, spatial, affordance, and counterfactual questions in addition to evaluating referring and open-vocabulary segmentation.

title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
abstract: Self-Geometry adapts 3D vision foundation models at test time using multiview pixel correspondences as geometric pseudo-labels. Its consistency objectives and gradient disentanglement are designed to improve geometry without ground-truth depth or camera annotations, using lightweight LoRA updates.

title: Compact Feed-Forward 3D Gaussians via Saliency-Guided Primitive Merging
abstract: This backbone-agnostic postprocessor compresses feed-forward 3D Gaussian predictions by clustering coherent primitives with saliency-guided adaptive superpixels, encoding them, and merging them across views. A level-of-detail decoder supports adjustable reconstruction budgets.

title: The GENEA Challenge 2026: A Large-Scale Disentangled Evaluation of Speech-Driven Gesture Generation on the Seamless Interaction Dataset
abstract: GENEA Challenge 2026 evaluates speech-driven gesture generation through four large user studies that separate motion quality, speech alignment, dyadic interaction, and semantic appropriateness. The results expose substantial remaining gaps to motion-capture references, particularly for interaction and meaning.

title: R4DSG: Relative 4D Scene Graph Memory for Object-Centric Question Answering in Long Egocentric Video
abstract: R4DSG represents long egocentric video as compact memory entries indexed by time, place, persistent objects, anchor-relative change, and interaction context. Stable anchors and relative transitions avoid requiring a globally aligned reconstruction while preserving object identity for question answering.

title: A Geodesic Cut-Cell Prior for Neural Skinning
abstract: Cut-cell skinning supplies neural skinning models with a fast graph approximation of volumetric geodesic distance. Axis-aligned ray intersections and winding-number queries build a graph that preserves separation between nearby surface parts, enabling a scalable geometric prior for in-the-wild meshes.

title: Seed2GS: Camera-Free, Training-Free Object Extraction from 3D Gaussian Scenes via a Single Reference-View Grounding
abstract: Seed2GS extracts an object from a frozen Gaussian-splat scene without the original reconstruction cameras or scene-specific representation training. It fixes identity in one grounded reference mask, lifts a conservative seed into 3D, expands coverage through visibility-adaptive virtual orbits and tracking, and fits one temporary foreground logit per Gaussian.

title: LiveAnimate: Stable Long-Form Streaming Human Animation in Real-Time
abstract: LiveAnimate converts a 14-billion-parameter bidirectional video diffusion transformer into a block-causal three-step generator for pose-driven streaming animation. A bounded cache combines a permanent reference anchor, pose-retrieved history, and a short rolling window to resist long-horizon identity and appearance drift.

title: StateFlow: Building, Evolving, and Accessing 3D World States for Previsualization
abstract: StateFlow organizes generative previsualization around a persistent, editable 3D world state rather than one-shot video synthesis. It constructs a world from generated views, applies structured state transitions while retaining memory, and uses render feedback to refine camera trajectories before optional video-model enhancement.

title: Surfsvr: 2D Surface Priors as 3D Geometric Regularizers for Sparse Voxel Reconstruction
abstract: SurfSVR converts coherent 2D surface regions into persistent 3D regularizers for sparse voxel reconstruction. Planar or quadratic surface models guide voxel subdivision, depth and normal optimization, pruning, and floater suppression in weakly textured or sparsely observed areas.

title: Map-Det3D: Metric Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Prior for Multi-view 3D Object Detection from Streaming Inputs
abstract: Map-Det3D repurposes a feed-forward metric 3D reconstruction model as the geometric backbone for online object detection from a short RGB video window. It predicts boxes directly in reconstructed metric space instead of detecting in 2D and lifting uncertain depth and scale afterward.

title: How Can Driving World Models Do Counterfactual Prediction?
abstract: This work argues that action-conditioned driving prediction is not automatically counterfactual because it ignores the factual continuation needed for causal abduction. A controlled benchmark and a training-free evidence-transfer pipeline test how much episode-specific information can be preserved under an alternative ego action.

title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
abstract: S2R closes the video-dereflection data loop with physics-grounded synthesis, a diffusion removal model, and a dedicated benchmark. Structure-space augmentation models blur, ghosting, and reflectance variation, while the removal model adapts video diffusion and adds one-step pixel-geometric refinement.

title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
abstract: AI4AI studies whether a stronger model can transfer capability to a weaker model at inference time by building a task harness rather than updating model weights. The harnesses move unstable reasoning into deterministic code, routing, and answer-format enforcement.

title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
abstract: SCULPT begins with a complete object in TRELLIS.2's structured 3D latent space and repeatedly predicts one extracted part together with the updated remainder. Coupled denoising, overlapping native sparse supports, and an explicit empty-remainder state make part count adaptive while retaining geometry, materials, and a shared object frame.

title: GeoCache: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View Texture Diffusion via Geometric Delta Transport
abstract: GeoCache accelerates multi-view texture diffusion without training by denoising a subset of anchor views and transporting their per-step clean-signal changes through geometry correspondences. Target views retain their own state, while periodic full-view passes restore regions poorly covered by the anchors.

title: EgoPHI: Estimating Contact and Force from Egocentric Vision
abstract: EgoPHI predicts dense contact maps and normal-force distributions on hand and object meshes from one egocentric RGB frame plus known object geometry. Physics simulation supplies scalable per-vertex supervision, while graph reasoning and iterative pose refinement align the interacting meshes before force estimation.

title: PixSDS: Why Latent SDS Makes Noisy Pixels
abstract: PixSDS diagnoses structured texture artifacts in latent score distillation as VAE-induced pixel drift: images can move along weakly encoded pixel-space directions while their latents remain clean. Its lightweight repair decodes a latent lookahead and uses that image as a VAE-consistent optimization direction.

title: LocusGS: Spatially Grounded Tokens for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: LocusGS gives each query token an explicit 3D center and support radius that are refined through the decoder. Anchor-to-ray bias gathers locally relevant multi-view observations, and anchor-centered decoding keeps each token's Gaussians spatially coherent rather than scattering them across the scene.

title: Structure-aware Riemannian Growth Fields for 4D Plant Modeling
abstract: This work models plant development as continuous geodesic flow constrained by botanical structure, combining symbolic growth rules with Riemannian geometry. A new ten-day, dual-species dataset provides dense geometry and semantic annotations for evaluating shape evolution and temporal correspondence.

title: Towards Physics-Faithful Generation of Scientific Diagrams
abstract: Princigram trains scientific-diagram generation with a fixed, subdiscipline-specific reasoning schema that separates visible facts from physical inferences and types mathematics symbolically. The accompanying pipeline annotates millions of physics images and evaluates each result through item-specific questions about forces, objects, and states.

title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
abstract: PlayWorld evaluates interactive video world models by asking multimodal agent players to pursue 171 long-horizon objectives rather than replaying one fixed action sequence. It measures geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, and whether visible and hidden scene state evolves persistently.

title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
abstract: AutoDesign uses a meta-harness optimizer to revise the tools and instructions around a code agent from rollout feedback. On academic paper-to-poster generation, the learned harness improves performance across several agent-model configurations and supports long autonomous editing trajectories.
